# Lint Rules

<!-- Generated by tests/test_docs.py; run it with --update-mdtest. -->

`sqlty check` runs every rule; `sqlty check --fix` applies the fixable ones.
`sqlty rule NAME` prints a rule's page.
Set severities to `"error"`, `"warn"` or `"ignore"` in `[tool.sqlty.rules]`:

```toml
[tool.sqlty.rules]
select-star = "ignore"
```

| Rule | Default | Fixable | Description |
|------|---------|---------|-------------|
| [`column-count-mismatch`](../src/sqlty/rules/column-count-mismatch.md) | error |  | Annotated type has different number of fields than query columns |
| [`column-type-mismatch`](../src/sqlty/rules/column-type-mismatch.md) | error |  | Annotated type field has incompatible type with query column |
| [`column-name-mismatch`](../src/sqlty/rules/column-name-mismatch.md) | warn |  | Annotated type field name doesn't match query column alias |
| [`typeddict-key-mismatch`](../src/sqlty/rules/typeddict-key-mismatch.md) | error |  | Query columns don't fit the keys of a closed or extra_items TypedDict |
| [`select-star`](../src/sqlty/rules/select-star.md) | warn | yes | SELECT * used — expand to explicit column list |
| [`select-star-no-schema`](../src/sqlty/rules/select-star-no-schema.md) | error |  | SELECT * used but no schema available to expand |
| [`stale-rewrite`](../src/sqlty/rules/stale-rewrite.md) | warn | yes | Source has --sql strings that aren't wrapped in SQL[T] |
| [`stale-type`](../src/sqlty/rules/stale-type.md) | warn | yes | SQL[tuple[...]] type doesn't match current schema (drift) |
| [`inline-sql-comment`](../src/sqlty/rules/inline-sql-comment.md) | warn | yes | --sql followed by space makes entire query a SQL comment; use "--sql\nSELECT ..." or run sqlty rewrite |
| [`fstring-skipped`](../src/sqlty/rules/fstring-skipped.md) | warn |  | f-string with --sql prefix skipped (cannot be statically rewritten) |
| [`tstring-skipped`](../src/sqlty/rules/tstring-skipped.md) | warn |  | t-string with --sql prefix skipped (cannot be statically rewritten) |
| [`untyped-query`](../src/sqlty/rules/untyped-query.md) | warn | yes | SQL[UNTYPED] query has no inferable row type; add casts or a schema |
